problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 30 units
* Package 2: size 43 units
* Package 3: size 56 units
* Package 4: size 69 units
* Package 5: size 53 units
* Package 6: size 49 units
* Package 7: size 35 units
* Package 8: size 31 units
* Package 9: size 45 units
* Package 10: size 69 units
* Package 11: size 31 units
* Package 12: size 67 units
* Package 13: size 62 units
* Package 14: size 53 units
* Package 15: size 39 units
* Package 16: size 59 units
* Package 17: size 46 units
* Package 18: size 37 units
* Package 19: size 67 units
* Package 20: size 58 units
* Package 21: size 47 units
* Package 22: size 44 units
* Package 23: size 54 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
